outputs.explanation: Panel A is a macroscopic photograph of intestines, not a plot of averaged data; the check does not apply.
Panel B is a histological micrograph (H&E staining), not a plot; the check does not apply.

Panel C contains a box plot (which is exempt as it already shows distribution) and a 3D bar chart of polyp numbers per genotype/diameter category showing only mean bar heights with no overlaid individual mouse data points, so the bar chart portion fails the requirement.
Panel D is a Kaplan-Meier survival line plot, a plot type exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel E includes a bar graph quantifying GTP-bound Rac1/Cdc42 levels relative to control, shown only as bars (with error bar for Cdc42) without individual data points plotted.
Panel F consists of immunohistochemistry micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel G includes a bar chart of relative expression (Asef, pJNK1, MMP9) with error bars but no individual data points overlaid on the bars; the right-hand blot panels contain no plot.
